claims: The Artemis II mission launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission lifted off on the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission carried four astronauts on a 10-day trip around the Moon.
Kennedy Space Center is located in Merritt Island, Florida.
The specific pad for the Artemis II mission launch is Launch Pad 39B.
The Artemis II mission launch was visible across most of Florida and parts of Georgia.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft to the vicinity of the Moon
